definitions.explanation: Having or showing an excessive willingness to serve or please others, often with an undignified, self-degrading manner.

examples.japanese: {卑屈|ひくつ}になる{必要|ひつよう}はない。
examples.english: There's no need to be so subservient.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}の{前|まえ}で{卑屈|ひくつ}に{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う{社員|しゃいん}。
examples.english: An employee who acts servile in front of the boss.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{卑屈|ひくつ}な{態度|たいど} - servile attitude
・{卑屈|ひくつ}になる - to become subservient
・{卑屈|ひくつ}に{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う - to behave servilely
・{卑屈|ひくつ}さ - servility (noun form)

NUANCE:
Strong negative connotation. Implies undignified, groveling behavior that sacrifices one's self-respect.

CONTRAST:
・{卑屈|ひくつ} - servile, cringing (negative extreme)
・{傲慢|ごうまん} - arrogant (opposite extreme)
・{謙虚|けんきょ} - humble (positive quality between the extremes)
